content:
# Getting Started with Karmyq

Welcome to Karmyq. This guide walks you through everything you need to get started.

---

## 1. Create an Account

Go to [karmyq.com](https://karmyq.com) and click **Register**.

You'll need: an email address, a display name, and a password. No phone number or credit card required.

---

## 2. Join a Community

**Browse public communities** — Go to **Communities** and look for communities near you or relevant to your interests.

**Accept an invitation** — If someone invited you, click the invitation link to join directly.

**Create your own** — Click **Create Community** to start a mutual aid group for your neighborhood, building, or organization.

---

## 3. Understand Your Starting State

When you join, you start with a baseline karma balance and no trust connections.

Some communities have a **karma lockout period** — a short window where new members can observe and contribute before posting high-effort requests. During this time, help others to build your reputation from day one.

---

## 4. Your First Action

The best way to get started is to **help someone first**.

Browse the feed and find a request you can fulfill. Completing it will earn you karma, build a trust connection, and signal to the community that you're here to contribute.

---
